# Meshk Prokashon (মেশক প্রকাশন) — Full Knowledge Dossier
Official Literary Archive, Publication Index, and Biography of Author Muhammod Jainul Abidin (মুহাম্মদ যাইনুল আবিদীন).

## 1. Institutional Overview
Meshk Prokashon (মেশক প্রকাশন) is an Islamic and Bengali literary publishing imprint headquartered in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Founded on the principle "বই আলো • বই সুবাস" (Books are Light, Books are Fragrance), the imprint specializes in high-caliber Bengali prose, Islamic classical scholarship, Prophet Muhammad's Seerat, Arabic linguistics, and socio-economic ethics.

## 2. Founder & Principal Author Biography
- Full Name: Maulana Muhammod Jainul Abidin (মুহাম্মদ যাইনুল আবিদীন)
- Birth: November 20, 1967 (Munshiganj, Bangladesh)
- Educational Alma Mater: Darul Uloom Deoband (India) — Dawra-e-Hadith & Advanced Higher Diploma in Arabic Literature (Adab)
- Profession: Islamic Scholar, Educator, Essayist, Biographer, and Public Orator
- Famous Maxim: "দুনিয়াতে আল্লাহ তায়ালার অসংখ্য নেয়ামত আছে, ভদ্রতার চেয়ে বড় কোনো নেয়ামত নাই।" (Among the countless blessings of Allah in this world, there is no greater blessing than good manners/civility).
